_doc: ONE voice for every tier (docs/research/samantha-initiative-2026-11-03.md, lanes E E4 / F E2): the fixed lines the fast tiers, the brain fallbacks, the error paths and the empty-transcript path speak, drafted once in the brain's manner. Loaded by voice_phrases.py; a variant is picked by hashing the turn key (never random), so a replay hears the same words. Rules (lexicons_data/en.json manner.block + the soul): short, contractions, no exclamation marks, at most one question, never 'I'm sorry, I didn't catch that', never 'Please try again'. 'sentinel': true = exactly one variant, because other code compares the text by equality (brain_dispatch, clean_goodbye, tests/replay_samples.py ERROR verdict, scripts/perf/samantha_bar.py, struggle_signals ERROR); 'brain_fallback': true = the text means the brain did not answer. '{name}' fields are filled by the caller and are part of the phrase's correctness (they name what happened). 'mirrors' = a copy that must stay byte-equal and lives where this file cannot be read (the Pi panel daemon); tests pin it.

reask._why: empty transcript on a channel that answers it (LiveKit): a short human re-ask, never a template
variants: I didn't quite get that. One more time?

brain_empty._why: typed chat: the brain returned no text; nothing was heard wrong, so it is not a re-ask
variants: Sorry, I lost my train of thought there. Can you send that again?
Hmm, I blanked on that one. Can you send it again?

brain_unreachable._why: zoe_flue_client._FALLBACK_TEXT: the brain lane failed (transport, non-2xx, empty)
variants: Sorry, I had trouble reaching my brain just now. Can you try that again?

turn_failed._why: routers/voice_tts._FALLBACK_PHRASE and the LiveKit/chat error lines: the turn itself broke
variants: Sorry, something went wrong there. Can you try that again?

action_failed._why: a confirmed or escalated action raised; nothing is claimed done
variants: Sorry, that didn't work. Can you try it again?
Hmm, that didn't go through. Want to try it again?

done._why: a confirmed write ran and its handler returned no text of its own

ack._why: a pending-form field edit with no field-specific reply

memory_saved._why: expert_dispatch teach fast path: names exactly what landed so the person can correct it

memory_saved_plain._why: expert_dispatch teach fast path when the fact cannot be echoed

memory_updated._why: expert_dispatch: a correction the extractor resolved (never echoes the raw negation)

memory_save_failed._why: expert_dispatch: the store raised; must say nothing was saved
variants: Hmm — I couldn't save that just now. Mind telling me again in a moment?

capture_lag._why: provenance_answers.render_summary: memory_capture_stats says a capture is still in flight, so the list is a moment behind what the user just said
variants: I'm still filing a few things you just told me.

hold_on._why: panel daemon, zoe-data restarting: spoken locally before the one retry

service_unreachable._why: panel daemon, zoe-data still down after the retry
variants: Sorry, I can't reach my brain right now. Try again in a minute.
